text:
Jordan (AE): starting Tamarack Bank POC discussion. They want streaming + function calls to normalize transaction records and strict typed JSON output. Asks: SDK handshake flow, sample func schema, POC pricing for 7 days at ~30 qps, and answers for security Qs. Who can own?
Maya (SE): I'll own runbook + infra checklist. Need minimal SDK sample and auth options (ephemeral vs api key). Also confirm Dedicated vs Private differences for logs/KMS.
Ethan (SDK): quick node example for streaming + func call:
```js
const rw = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = rw.stream({ model: 'rwd-medium', stream: true });
stream.on('data', d => console.log('part', d));
await rw.call({ prompt: 'Extract txn', functions: [{ name: 'tx_normalize', schema: { type: 'object', properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, amount: { type: 'number' }, date: { type: 'string', format: 'date' } }, required: ['id','amount'] } }] });
```
Ethan (SDK): note: final func output arrives as `func_call` event; use `stream.collectFinal()` helper. Use Idempotency-Key header for tool calls to prevent double-processing.
Riya (Security): they asked about CMEK, audit log retention, VPC-only logs. Short answers: CMEK/HSM = supported in Private; Dedicated supports peering and restricted logs but not full CMEK control. Logs to VPC = Private only. I'll draft full template answers.
Maya (SE): pricing rough: small dedicated slot for 7 days + usage; estimate ~$3.5k-6k depending on model and token count. Can offer discounted trial reserved unit.
ops-bot: ticket POC-8891 created and runbook linked: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tamarack-poc
Jordan (AE): next actions: Ethan publish sample repo + validation helper link by EOD, Maya draft pricing + checklist, Riya prep questionnaire responses. Sync tomorrow 11am PT. :thumbsup:
